program.name: Bell Pilates Full
program.subject: Kettlebell Pilates
program.blurb: Long, whole-body Pilates sessions with a light kettlebell all the way through.
program.about: A whole Pilates session with a light kettlebell from start to finish. Bell roll-ups and chest lifts, bell bridges and plié pulses, bell saws and twists, then mat rolling to close. Two orders alternate. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps.
